snippet.title: PAO PAO - Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
PAO PAO will be released on 26 October 2026 for PC and Xbox.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3024130/PAO_PAO/

Explore a lively town where every day brings something new. Meet quirky characters, discover cozy little spots and landmarks, gather resources in the wild, or simply wander around and see what’s happening. With changing weather, seasons and a full day-night cycle, PAO PAO is always a little different. 

Turn a small kitchen into a restaurant of your dreams. Arrange your equipment, create your menu and serve everything from simple meals to a packed house full of hungry customers. Play solo or work together with up to 4 players to keep the kitchen running and grow your restaurant. 

Developer: ArtDock
X: https://x.com/PaoPao_game
